wire.extensions: optional namespaced x-* scalars only; not implicit permission to use new capability

capabilities.portable_offline_package: deferred C23; same logical observation schema does not claim package crypto/format implementation
capabilities.legacy_unknown_section_status: explicit adapter only; native sources rejected

legacy.collector_id_mapping: collector-origin becomes origin_source_id; transit collector_id is separate route
legacy.scope_local: documented alias host only for portable parser; does not rename permanent agent
legacy.sqlite_v1: no direct DB compatibility; migration adapter C32

digest: SHA-256(RFC8785 canonical UTF-8 payload); lowercase hex
signature: Ed25519(domain ASCII + RFC8785 payload); unpadded base64url
enrollment: grant prebinds SHA256 DER CSR and exact signing public key; renewal needs proof by existing origin signing key and cert_renew challenge
